= About Edpuzzle =
[https://www.edpuzzle.com Edpuzzle] is a digital learning platform, created in 2013 by Quim Sabria. [ref: ] In Edpuzzle, teachers create a digital class, and submit assignments for students to complete. [ref: What is Edpuzzle and How Does It Work?, Tech & Learning] Students can sign in with Classlink, Clever, Google, and Microsoft. Teachers can create an account, provided they are over the age of 18.

Assignments consist of educational YouTube videos with questions inputted into the video, pausing the video at each question. They can be multiple-choice questions, or questions where the student types their answer. Assignments can be in groups, or as an individual. [ref: Edpuzzle Explained: Features, Benefits, and Pricing Guide - Nibble Blog, nibble-app.com] Edpuzzle also gives detailed information about the questions each student got right and wrong, and more. [ref: Edpuzzle Review 2026 – Features, Pricing & Alternatives, Just Learn]On the teacher side, the AI Assist Feature assists teachers in creating Edpuzzle assignments, cutting down on the time required to plan.

Edpuzzle is used widely by many districts across the United States.

data.title: Underground Fire
data.text:
Underground Fire is a Swedish rock band formed in Karlstad, Sweden, in 2015 by musician Robert Fjällsby, better known as Rob Coffinshaker. The band's music incorporates elements of gothic rock, punk rock, post-punk, power pop and classic rock. [ref: Underground Fire, Bandcamp]

The band has released two studio albums, Ashes of Life (2020) and Hollow Grounds (2026), as well as several singles and other releases.

==History==

Underground Fire was formed in Karlstad in 2015 by Robert Fjällsby, who performs under the name Rob Coffinshaker. Fjällsby is also known for his work with the bands The Coffinshakers and Gehennah.

The band's early releases appeared in 2017, including the 7-inch singles Underground Fire and I Wasn't Made For This World. The singles "Summer Ends" and "End of the Night" followed in 2018.

The band's debut studio album, Ashes of Life, was released in 2020 by Critical Mass Recordings. It was recorded at Studio Cobra in Stockholm, with Martin "Konie" Ehrencrona involved in the recording and production. [ref: Ashes of Life, Bandcamp]

A 12-inch release titled Passage, featuring the songs "Passage" and "Poison Heart", was released by Critical Mass Recordings in 2021. [ref: Passage, Bandcamp]

The band's second studio album, Hollow Grounds, was released on 17 April 2026 by Critical Mass Recordings. [ref: UNDERGROUND FIRE releases second album!, Critical Mass Recordings]

==Musical style==

Underground Fire's music has been described as goth rock, incorporating elements of punk, power pop, post-punk and classic rock. Reviews of the band's releases have drawn comparisons with The Sisters of Mercy, The Leather Nun, Fields of the Nephilim, Blue Öyster Cult and Johnny Cash. [ref: Review - UNDERGROUND FIRE - Ashes Of Life, Ox Fanzine] [ref: Arvio: Underground Firen ajattomasti menneisyydestä lipuva musiikki kietoo kuulijan syleilyynsä kuin usva, jolla on tietoisuus, Soundi]

==Media coverage==

Swedish journalist and author Fredrik Strage has written about Underground Fire in connection with the band's second studio album. In a 2026 column for EFN, Strage included Hollow Grounds among new album releases and described the band's music as goth rock. [ref: Berlin är fortfarande som en injektion mousserande neon, EFN]

On 30 July 2026, Rob Coffinshaker appeared as a guest on Strage's podcast Hemma hos Strage in an episode titled "Rob Coffinshaker om mördarballader". The episode discusses Coffinshaker's musical career and his work with Underground Fire. [ref: Rob Coffinshaker om mördarballader, Acast]

data.title: Jeremie Lefevre
data.text:
Jeremie H. Lefevre (born 1977; French: Jérémie Lefevre) is a French colorectal surgeon and professor of digestive surgery at Sorbonne University and Hôpital Saint-Antoine in Paris. He is known for research on hereditary colorectal cancer syndromes, for coordinating the GRECCAR-6 randomised trial on the interval between chemoradiotherapy and surgery in rectal cancer, and for work on the management of anastomotic leaks after colorectal surgery. He is secretary general of the French Society of Digestive Surgery (Société française de chirurgie digestive, SFCD).

== Education and career ==
Lefevre studied medicine at the Pitié-Salpêtrière faculty of Pierre and Marie Curie University. He was a surgical resident of the Paris hospitals from 2002, obtained his medical doctorate in 2008 and was awarded the AP-HP gold medal in surgery the same year. [ref: Les médailles d'or de l'AP-HP, aaihp.fr] After a research fellowship in Walter Bodmer's laboratory at the Weatherall Institute of Molecular Medicine, University of Oxford (2008–2009), he completed a PhD on familial colorectal cancer at Pierre and Marie Curie University in 2012. [ref: Role of rare variants in undetermined multiple adenomatous polyposis and early-onset colorectal cancer, Journal of Human Genetics]

He was appointed associate professor (maître de conférences des universités – praticien hospitalier) in 2012 [ref: Arrêté portant admission au concours de recrutement de maîtres de conférences des universités – praticiens hospitaliers au titre de l'année 2012, legifrance.gouv.fr] and full professor (professeur des universités – praticien hospitalier) of general surgery by presidential decree of 13 October 2015, with assignment to the department of general and digestive surgery of Hôpital Saint-Antoine. [ref: Décret du 13 octobre 2015 portant nomination, titularisation et affectation (enseignements supérieurs), legifrance.gouv.fr] [ref: Pr Jérémie Lefevre, aphp.fr] Since November 2025 he has headed the department of visceral and digestive surgery of the Sorbonne University faculty of health and coordinated the Île-de-France residency programme (DES) in visceral and digestive surgery. [ref: Arrêté n° SU/DAJI/2026/303 portant nomination, Sorbonne Université]

== Research ==
Lefevre's early work, with Yann Parc at Saint-Antoine, concerned the genetics of colorectal polyposis, including the role of MUTYH in colorectal polyposis, [ref: Implication of MYH in colorectal polyposis, Annals of Surgery] risk factors for desmoid tumours in familial adenomatous polyposis [ref: Risk factors for development of desmoid tumours in familial adenomatous polyposis, British Journal of Surgery] and screening for Lynch syndrome. [ref: Screening for Lynch Syndrome in Colorectal Cancer: Are We Doing Enough?, Annals of Surgical Oncology] As a member of Alex Duval's Inserm team on microsatellite instability and cancer, he contributed to the identification of HSP110 mutations as a prognostic factor in MSI colorectal cancer. [ref: Expression of a mutant HSP110 sensitizes colorectal cancer cells to chemotherapy and improves disease prognosis, Nature Medicine]

He was the coordinating investigator of GRECCAR-6, a French multicentre randomised trial comparing a 7-week and an 11-week interval between the end of neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy and surgery for rectal cancer. The trial, published in the Journal of Clinical Oncology in 2016, found no increase in pathological complete response with the longer interval but higher morbidity; [ref: Effect of Interval (7 or 11 weeks) Between Neoadjuvant Radiochemotherapy and Surgery on Complete Pathologic Response in Rectal Cancer: A Multicenter, Randomized, Controlled Trial (GRECCAR-6), Journal of Clinical Oncology] three-year [ref: Does A Longer Waiting Period After Neoadjuvant Radio-chemotherapy Improve the Oncological Prognosis of Rectal Cancer?: Three Years' Follow-up Results of the Greccar-6 Randomized Multicenter Trial, Annals of Surgery] and five-year [ref: Final Results of the GRECCAR-6 Trial on Waiting Period Following Neoadjuvant Radiochemotherapy for Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer: 5 Years of Follow-up, Diseases of the Colon & Rectum] follow-up confirmed the absence of oncological benefit. Within the GRECCAR group he also led a multicentre cohort of 564 patients on delayed coloanal anastomosis [ref: Is Delaying a Coloanal Anastomosis the Ideal Solution for Rectal Surgery: Analysis of a Multicentric Cohort of 564 Patients from the GRECCAR, Annals of Surgery] and a study of outpatient stoma closure. [ref: Outpatient Stoma Closure in 130 Patients. Insights From the GRECCAR Multicentric Study, Annals of Surgery]

A second line of work concerns anastomotic leakage after colorectal surgery: early detection by C-reactive protein, [ref: C-Reactive Protein Values After Colorectal Resection: Can We Discharge a Patient With a C-Reactive Protein Value >100? A Retrospective Cohort Study, Diseases of the Colon & Rectum] conservative management by local drainage, [ref: Can a Local Drainage Salvage a Failed Colorectal or Coloanal Anastomosis? A Prospective Cohort of 54 Patients, Diseases of the Colon & Rectum] and redo surgery for failed colorectal or coloanal anastomoses. [ref: Redo surgery for failed colorectal or coloanal anastomosis: A valuable surgical challenge, Surgery] [ref: Redo Coloanal Anastomosis: A Retrospective Study of 66 Patients, Annals of Surgery] He is a member of the international TENTACLE collaboratives on the treatment of anastomotic leakage [ref: Stoma-free Survival After Rectal Cancer Resection With Anastomotic Leakage: Development and Validation of a Prediction Model in a Large International Cohort, Annals of Surgery] and coordinates the SAFE trials evaluating an endoluminal anastomotic protection device (Colovac) intended to avoid diverting stomas after rectal resection. [ref: Evaluation of the SafeHeal Colovac+ anastomosis protection device after low anterior resection for rectal cancer: the safe anastomosis feasibility evaluation (SAFE) 2019 trial, Surgical Endoscopy] [ref: Jérémie H. Lefevre – Faculty, aismedicalnetwork.com] He sits on the scientific advisory board of SafeHeal, the company developing the device. [ref: Company – Scientific Advisory Board, SafeHeal]

Other work includes ileal pouch–anal anastomosis (laparoscopic approach and fertility), [ref: A Total Laparoscopic Approach Reduces the Infertility Rate After Ileal Pouch-Anal Anastomosis: A 2-Center Study, Annals of Surgery] emergency surgery for obstructing colon cancer within the French Surgical Association (AFC) working group, [ref: Prognostic factors and patterns of recurrence after emergency management for obstructing colon cancer: multivariate analysis from a series of 2120 patients, Langenbeck's Archives of Surgery] and ambulatory management of acute appendicitis. [ref: Management of Acute Appendicitis in Ambulatory Surgery: Is It Possible? How to Select Patients?, Annals of Surgery]

He has authored or co-authored more than 370 indexed articles, [ref: lefevre jh – PubMed, pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov] with an h-index of 65 according to Google Scholar (October 2026), [ref: lefevre jh – Google Scholar, scholar.google.fr] and serves on the editorial advisory board of Colorectal Disease. [ref: Colorectal Disease – Editorial Board, Wiley]

== Professional roles ==
Lefevre has been a board member of the French Society of Digestive Surgery (SFCD) since 2016 and its secretary general since 2020. [ref: Membres du Bureau et du CA, Société française de chirurgie digestive] He is an elected member of the French National Council of Universities (sub-section 52-02, visceral and digestive surgery) for 2025–2030, [ref: Composition du CNU pour les disciplines de santé au 1er janvier 2026, Ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur et de la Recherche] a member of the GRECCAR board, and co-editor of the French college of visceral and digestive surgery's textbook (Med-Line) and of the KB Hépatologie, gastro-entérologie, chirurgie viscérale manual (Vernazobres-Grego). [ref: Pr Jérémie Lefevre, Éditions Med-Line] [ref: Hépatologie, gastro-entérologie, chirurgie viscérale, Vernazobres-Grego] He has also contributed chapters to international textbooks, including the chapter on rectovaginal fistula in Steele's Colon and Rectal Surgery (Wolters Kluwer). [ref: Steele's Colon and Rectal Surgery, Wolters Kluwer]

He is a mentor in the European Society of Coloproctology's "Mentors sans frontières" programme, hosting senior colorectal trainees from across Europe at Saint-Antoine Hospital. [ref: Mentors sans frontières, escp.eu.com]

== Honours ==
* AP-HP gold medal in surgery (2008)
* Jean and Madeleine Schaeverbeke Prize of the Fondation de France for research on colon cancer (2008) [ref: Instabilité des microsatellites et cancer: de l'instabilité du génome à la médecine personnalisée, Médecine/sciences]
* Young Leader of the French-American Foundation (2017) [ref: Young Leaders: "Nous les choisissons dans tous les domaines", parismatch.com]
* European Surgical Association exchange fellow at the American Surgical Association annual meeting (2024) [ref: ESA/ASA Exchange Programme, European Surgical Association]

== Selected publications ==
* Complete cytoreductive surgery plus intraperitoneal chemohyperthermia with oxaliplatin for peritoneal carcinomatosis of colorectal origin, Journal of Clinical Oncology
* Effect of interval (7 or 11 weeks) between neoadjuvant radiochemotherapy and surgery on complete pathologic response in rectal cancer: a multicenter, randomized, controlled trial (GRECCAR-6), Journal of Clinical Oncology
* Career choices of medical students: a national survey of 1780 students, Medical Education

data.title: Christodoulos Constantinou
data.text:
Christodoulos Constantinou was born in 2007, in Paphos, Cyprus. He emerged in the Cypriot classical music scene at a young age, composing music for the theatre - ancient and modern drama, and mainly concert classical music. His music is often characterized as expressionistic, neoromantic, and surrealistic. Major influences on him are literature, poetry, and cinema, but mainly his personal experiences and social perceptions. He studies Composition at the Conservatorium van Amsterdam in the Netherlands.

At the age of 16, he completed the Composition intensive at The Juilliard School, where his first major pieces were performed and he had masterclasses with John Corigliano, Wynton Marsalis, Eric Whitacre, John Mackey, Tania León, Amy Beth Kirsten and others, and continued studying with Daniel Felsenfeld.
Pieces of his have been performed in Cyprus, Greece, Slovenia, the USA, the Netherlands and Italy. He has been awarded the first prize in the Brahms Competition(2025) and also won first and third prizes in the 6th International Music Olympiad in Cyprus(2024) and the 5th International Music Olympiad in Slovenia(2021). He also served in the military band of the Cypriot National Guard (ΣΜΕΦ), as a trumpet player.

== Selected Works ==

* Inferno - Variations on an orthodox hymn based on Dante's Inferno, Violin, Violoncello, Piano
* Blue Hautboy - Oboe
* Music for Ancient Greek Drama - Eleni by Euripides, Vocals, Cretan Lyre, Double Bass Violin, Piano
* The Tell-Tale Heart - based on Edgar Allan Poe's The Tell-Tale Heart, Flute, Viola, Bass Drum, Piano
* Music for modern Greek Comedy - "Avgoustiatiko Feggari" - Vocals, Greek Bouzouki, Acoustic Guitar, Violin, Percussion
* Un dia en Madrid - for children string orchestra
* Wild Strawberries - based on Ingmar Bergman's Wild Strawberries, Piano
* When Nietzsche got drunk - Flute, Trumpet, Acoustic Guitar, Electric Guitar, Greek Bouzouki, Snare, Bass Drum, Cymbal, Triangle, Recitation, Piano
* The Black Cat - based on Edgar Allan Poe's The Black Cat, Flute, Viola, Cymbal, Triangle, Bass Drum, Piano
* Iakoumikeion - Clarinet
* Violin Sonata - Violin, Piano
* False Symmetry - Flute, Oboe, Clarinet, French Horn, Bassoon

data.title: Ivan Fernando Rodríguez Huerta Bio
data.text:
----

Ivan Fernando Rodríguez Huerta is a Mexican-born global operations executive, supply chain strategist, and author based in the United States. He serves as the Vice President of Exploration Tooling and Global Supply Chain at Boart Longyear, a multinational provider of drilling services and equipment for the global mining industry. Over a multi-decade career, Rodríguez has directed multinational operations and published frameworks detailing industrial management, lean manufacturing, and leadership sciences.

== Early Life and Education ==

Rodríguez was born in Mexico and pursued academic training focused on industrial operations. He attended the Tecnológico de Monterrey before continuing his professional business management studies at the University of Phoenix.

== Career ==

Rodríguez's career spans more than 25 years of leadership within international industrial, manufacturing, and technology sectors. Early in his career, he held sequential operational and supply chain management responsibilities at industrial manufacturing firms, including Honeywell, Robertshaw, and Bundy Refrigeration.

He later served as the Chief Transformation Officer for Current Lighting, an electrical equipment manufacturer, where he directed corporate restructuring and optimized multi-facility supply chains.

In January 2025, Rodríguez joined the executive leadership roster at Boart Longyear as the Vice President of Exploration Tooling and Global Supply Chain. Operating out of the company’s corporate headquarters in Salt Lake City, Utah, his responsibilities include overseeing global tooling innovation, engineering, safety metrics, and managing a scaled workforce across manufacturing facilities.

=== Private Ventures ===

In April 2026, Rodríguez registered two private corporate structures in the state of Utah: Healthy Life Vending Machines LLC and Reimagined Solutions Group LLC. The latter is configured as a boutique corporate consultancy specializing in global supply chain optimization and lean business modeling.

== Published Works ==

Rodríguez writes on organizational behavior, executive navigation, and technical logistics. His core work includes:

* Management, Leadership, and Decision Sciences: An Executive Framework

== Honors and Recognition ==

In early 2026, Rodríguez was selected for induction into the Marquis Who's Who biographical registry for his track record in corporate turnarounds and servant leadership models.

data.title: Jonathane Ricci
data.text:
----

Jonathane Ricci

Jonathane Ricci is a lawyer licensed in New York and Michigan. The New York State Unified Court System lists Jonathane Michael Ricci as a currently registered attorney. The State Bar of Michigan's attorney directory lists Jonathane M. Ricci as an active member in good standing.[1][2]

JR Wealth Management identifies Ricci as its founder and chief executive officer.[3] Because this description comes from the company's own website, it is used here only as an attributed statement and not as independent evidence of notability.

Education and student leadership

Ricci studied at the Detroit College of Law at Michigan State University. The law school's Spring 1998 issue of Amicus identified him as a member of the class of 1998 and as president of the Detroit College of Law/Michigan State University Student Bar Association during the 1997–1998 academic year.[4]

The issue appeared during a period of institutional transition for the law school. Its cover story described the Detroit College of Law at Michigan State University and the dedication of a new law-school building in East Lansing on April 21, 1998.[4]

Student Bar Association presidency

In “Forging Traditions of the Future,” published in Amicus, Ricci described the Student Bar Association as a longstanding part of student life at the law school. He wrote that the organization had previously been known as the Student Senate and discussed changes to its structure, executive positions, and constitution during the school's transition to Michigan State University.[4]

The article described Ricci's role as president during 1997 and 1998 and referred to the association's work representing students, organizing student participation, and developing the structure of student government. It also discussed the election of student officers and the creation or clarification of executive responsibilities within the association.[4]

Ricci's article addressed the relationship between student leadership and the future direction of the law school. It emphasized student involvement, participation in school affairs, and the importance of preserving institutional traditions while adapting to the law school's new affiliation.[4]

1998 building dedication and speech

An archival video held by Michigan State University's University Archives and Historical Collections documents the April 21, 1998, dedication of the Detroit College of Law building at the Wharton Center on the MSU campus. The archive identifies former United States president Gerald R. Ford as the event's keynote speaker and lists the recording as part of the Media Communications Records, resource identifier A008293.[5]

In the recording, the dean introduces Ricci as the president of the Detroit College of Law at Michigan State University Student Bar Association and as a member of the law school's graduating class of 1998. The introduction occurs at approximately 57 minutes and 22 seconds into the recording. Ford is introduced later as the 38th president of the United States and keynote speaker.[5]

Ricci then addresses the audience from the platform at approximately 57 minutes and 40 seconds. He identifies himself as a graduating student and Student Bar Association president, thanks the platform guests, and explains that he was invited to speak on behalf of the students. He discusses his perspective as a student who began his legal education at the Detroit campus and completed it at the East Lansing campus, and describes the law school's traditions, faculty, students, and expected opportunities at Michigan State University. He concludes by thanking those attending and inviting them to join the procession to the new law-college building. His remarks continue until approximately 61 minutes and 57 seconds.[5]

The recording shows Ricci speaking on the same platform at which Ford is present. It therefore provides direct archival evidence that Ricci and Ford appeared at the same building-dedication event and shared the platform during the ceremony.[5]

Legal career

The New York State Unified Court System attorney record lists Ricci's date of admission as July 19, 2011, and identifies the Third Department as his department of admission. The record lists his registration status as “Currently registered.”[1]

The State Bar of Michigan directory lists Ricci's Michigan license number as P58740 and his admission date as November 20, 1998. It describes his status as “Active Member in Good Standing.”[2]

JR Wealth Management

JR Wealth Management's website describes Ricci as the firm's founder and identifies the organization with wealth-management and related strategic services.[3] As a company-controlled source, the website is suitable for documenting the company's own description of its leadership, services, and branding, but it does not by itself establish independent recognition or Wikipedia notability.

A press release distributed through Business Wire on October 28, 2024, announced the launch of a JR Wealth Management family-office service called “Wealth Preserver.” The release identified Ricci as the firm's founder and chief executive officer and described the service as addressing wealth preservation, tax planning, legal and regulatory matters, financial growth management, inheritance planning, philanthropy, and family governance.[6] These descriptions are statements attributed to the company and should not be presented as independent assessments of the service or of Ricci's professional standing.

A separate September 21, 2026, release distributed by GlobeNewswire announced an expansion of JR Wealth Management's “Reputation Protection & Strategic Response” service. The release said the service was intended to help individuals, professionals, and businesses assess how search engines, social platforms, online databases, and artificial-intelligence systems present information about them. It described activities including digital-footprint assessment, documentation, evaluation of online narratives, response planning, and coordination with outside specialists where appropriate.[7]

The September 2026 release also quoted Ricci discussing the effect of online information on professional opportunities, banking relationships, clients, investors, partnerships, and trust.[7] The release stated that the service was advisory and consulting work and was not itself private-investigative work or jurisdiction-specific legal representation.[7]

The Globe and Mail page carrying the September 2026 material labels it as syndicated third-party content and states that the publication did not review or endorse the content. The Business Wire item is likewise a company press release distributed through a commercial news-release service. Both sources can document what JR Wealth Management announced about its own services, but neither should be treated as independent journalistic coverage establishing notability.[6][7]

data.title: Trevor Blank
data.text:
Trevor J. Blank is an American folklorist and associate professor of communication at the State University of New York at Potsdam. His research focuses on digital culture and Internet folklore.

== Education ==
In 2005, Blank earned a bachelor's degree in American Studies from the University of Maryland, Baltimore County, where he became interested in folklore as an undergraduate after meeting Charlie Kemp, then the state folklorist of Maryland. Kemp encouraged him to pursue graduate study in the field. [ref: Notes on the Authors] [ref: Humor Makes Life More Tolerable. Interview with American Folklorist Trevor J. Blank, Folklore] He earned a master's degree in folklore from Indiana University in 2007 and his Ph.D. in American Studies from Pennsylvania State University, Harrisburg in 2011. [ref: AMST Alum Prof. Trevor J. Blank is this year's URCAD Speaker]

== Career ==
In 2009, he published the anthology "Folklore and the Internet: Vernacular Expression in a Digital World". [ref: ] He is an associate professor in the Department of Communication at the State University of New York at Potsdam. [ref: Trevor J. Blank, University Press of Colorado]

== Awards ==
In 2009, Blank received the Richard Reuss Prize for Students of Folklore and History from the History and Folklore Section of the American Folklore Society for his essay "The History of the Hoosier Folklore Society, 1937–2007." [ref: Richard Reuss Prize, The American Folklore Society] In 2010, he received the William Wells Newell Prize in Children's Folklore from the American Folklore Society for his research on children's folklore. [ref: Penn State professor's essay on farting takes the prize, pennlive]

== Publications ==
=== Author ===
* Spring Grove State Hospital (2008, with David S. Helsel)
* The Last Laugh: Folk Humor, Celebrity Culture, and Mass-Mediated Disasters in the Digital Age (2013)
* Toward a Conceptual Framework for the Study of Folklore and the Internet (2014)
* Maryland Legends: Folklore from the Old Line State (2014, with David J. Puglia) [ref: Blank, Trevor J, viaf.org]

=== Editor and co-editor ===
* Folklore and the Internet: Vernacular Expression in a Digital World (2009)

data.text:
Struck Crescendo is a solo music project created by American musician and multimedia creator Ace Fletcher Moss, also known as Gavin Moss. Moss uses they/them pronouns and is based in the St. Louis, Missouri area. Their work encompasses songwriting, recording, music production, graphic design, video editing, branding, and digital distribution. According to their portfolio, Moss independently wrote, recorded, produced, and published the project's music, while also managing its visual identity, artwork direction, distribution, and promotion. [ref: Ace Moss — Portfolio, Ace Moss]

The project's releases include the debut album Staying in My Bed (2024), followed by Five Days Till' Death (2025) and You're Not Honest (2026). Its catalog also includes extended plays and singles released through digital music services. The releases have been categorized as pop and indie rock by streaming platforms, although classifications vary between individual releases. [ref: Staying in My Bed, Amazon Music] [ref: Five Days Till' Death, Apple Music] [ref: You're Not Honest, Apple Music]

== Biography ==

=== Early life and creative development ===
Moss was born on May 17, 2011, in St. Louis, Missouri. According to the biography supplied through their artist profile, they began experimenting with graphic design and video editing during early childhood, learning to use Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Premiere Pro by approximately four years of age. By around eight, they had begun recording, writing, and editing YouTube videos and had started earning money through graphic design. [ref: Ace Moss, Spotify]

Moss's creative work subsequently expanded into music. At approximately eleven years old, they began using GarageBand and Ableton Live to record, arrange, and produce original compositions. Their interests extended beyond songwriting and recording to the surrounding work required to release music, including graphic design, branding, artwork, and digital distribution.

These early experiences in visual media and digital production informed Moss's approach to independent music-making. Their portfolio describes a practice that combines music production with project management and other digital creative disciplines, including web design and game development.

=== Formation and development ===
Struck Crescendo developed as Moss's solo music project. Rather than limiting their involvement to songwriting or performance, Moss managed multiple stages of the project's production and release process. Their portfolio identifies original music creation, recording, production, publishing, branding, artwork direction, distribution, and promotion among their responsibilities.

The project's releases document its development from the debut album Staying in My Bed in 2024 through subsequent albums, extended plays, and singles. Its digital catalog includes both longer collections and standalone releases, with distribution through Bandcamp and major streaming services. [ref: Struck Crescendo — Discography, Bandcamp]

== Music ==
Struck Crescendo's catalog includes releases categorized by streaming platforms under pop, indie rock, and related popular-music classifications. Apple Music lists Staying in My Bed under pop and You're Not Honest and the single Insomnia under indie rock. [ref: Insomnia — Single, Apple Music]

Moss's approach to the project combines music creation with the production of visual and promotional materials. Their portfolio identifies them as responsible for the project's branding, artwork direction, and promotion, in addition to the writing, recording, production, and publication of its music.

Other tracks include "Chicago", "Is It Over", "Seashells", "Without You (Interlude)", "Mr. X", "Love Is Dead", "what a ride", "The Pity Committee", "Never Ever", and "c0ntact passw0rd".

data.title: Toden (company)
data.text:
----

Toden is an identity verification and risk-management software company. [ref: KYC & Identity Verification Platform, Toden]

Its platform combines Know Your Customer (KYC), Know Your Business (KYB), biometric authentication, anti-money laundering (AML) screening, fraud detection, transaction monitoring and automated risk decisioning. These services are delivered through application programming interfaces (APIs), software development kits (SDKs) and a web-based management platform. [ref: The Platform: trust infrastructure for digital businesses, Toden]

== Products and services ==

=== Identity verification ===

Toden provides Know Your Customer (KYC) infrastructure that enables businesses to verify individuals using government-issued identity documents, official records and biometric authentication. [ref: Identity Verification (KYC), Toden]

The platform supports identity document and facial verification across 240 countries and regions. Government database verification is available in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa and Côte d'Ivoire.

Through facial deduplication technology, Toden can identify potential matches between newly submitted biometric records and identities previously verified within the same customer's organisation. This capability is designed to support the detection of repeated registrations, identity misuse and certain forms of multi-account fraud. [ref: Face Search, Toden]

=== Business verification ===

Toden's Know Your Business (KYB) services enable organisations to verify companies and assess the identities of individuals associated with them. [ref: Business Verification (KYB), Toden]

The system combines company registry searches, corporate documentation checks, director verification, beneficial ownership assessment and compliance screening.

=== Risk intelligence and fraud prevention ===

The system combines information from customer identities, devices, network activity, transactions, behavioural patterns and compliance screening results to support risk assessment.

Its capabilities include transaction risk scoring, device and IP intelligence, suspicious activity detection, cryptocurrency wallet screening, sanctions screening, politically exposed person (PEP) screening and adverse-media monitoring. [ref: Risk Intelligence, Toden]

The platform supports configurable decision rules that allow businesses to approve transactions, decline high-risk activities, request additional verification or refer cases for human review.

Toden also provides investigation and case management tools that record alerts, evidence, decisions and reviewer actions. These records can help businesses with compliance reviews and preparing suspicious activity reports.

=== Automated compliance and continuous monitoring ===

The platform supports ongoing sanctions and watchlist screening, transaction monitoring, activity-based alerts, customer re-verification and risk-based investigation workflows.

Its visual workflow builder allows compliance and risk teams to configure verification steps and decision policies without modifying their application's source code.

== Technology ==

The company provides SDKs for React, React Native and Flutter, alongside hosted verification sessions, server-side APIs and signed webhooks. [ref: Toden KYC and identity verification documentation, Toden]

The platform also incorporates audit trails, configurable access controls and data protection mechanisms for handling sensitive identity and financial information. [ref: Privacy Policy, Toden]

== International coverage ==

NFC chip verification supports documents issued by up to 138 countries, according to the company's developer documentation.

In Africa, Toden provides government-record verification in five markets: Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa and Côte d'Ivoire.

The platform also supports business registry verification in multiple international jurisdictions, although the depth of available information differs by market.

== Business model ==

Its pricing is primarily usage-based, allowing customers to pay for individual verification, screening and risk management components.

The modular model enables businesses to select specific services, such as identity verification, business checks, biometric authentication or transaction monitoring, rather than purchasing a fixed combination of products.

Toden also provides a sandbox environment for developers to test integrations before processing live verification requests.

AMARA ctk100 is a Swiss and Italian pop music artist. She writes, produces and sings her songs [ref: Amara ctk100 - COEVAL Magazine, COEVAL]. data.title: Tijori Robo Investing
data.text:
----

== Introduction ==
Tijori Robo Investing is a Pakistani digital investment advisory platform operated by Shaikha Robo Securities (Private) Limited, a securities adviser licensed by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP). The platform provides risk-based investment portfolios and securities advisory services, with brokerage execution and custody services provided through Chase Securities. [ref: ]

Tijori is designed primarily for individuals seeking to participate in Pakistan's equity markets through a structured investment approach without independently selecting and allocating every security in their investment portfolios. The platform incorporates features commonly associated with robo-investing technology, including investor risk profiling, model portfolio allocation, proportionate investment calculations and portfolio rebalancing tools. [ref: ]

Brokerage and custody services associated with the platform are provided through Chase Securities Pakistan (Private) Limited, a securities broker registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) and a Trading Rights Entitlement Certificate (TREC) holder of the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Shaikha Robo Securities provides the technology platform and investment interface, while Chase Securities provides the brokerage infrastructure through which client securities transactions are processed. [ref: Shaikha Robo Securities Pvt Ltd Securities Advisor License]

The platform operates through a non-discretionary transaction model in which users retain responsibility for reviewing and authorizing securities transactions. Investment allocations and transaction calculations may be generated through software, but orders require client authorization before submission for execution.

Tijori's investment approach focuses on portfolio construction, diversification, periodic contributions and long-term participation in the equity market. The platform also provides educational resources intended to explain financial markets and investment concepts to retail users. [ref: ]

== History ==

=== Corporate background ===
Tijori Robo Investing was developed as a digital investment initiative intended to make participation in Pakistan's capital markets more accessible to individual investors.

The platform is associated with Shaikha Robo Securities (Private) Limited, a private company incorporated in Pakistan. Its founder and chief executive officer, Shahzeb Shaikha, has professional experience in financial services, securities brokerage and wealth management, including roles at Prudential Financial and Oppenheimer & Co. Inc. His professional background includes United States FINRA Series 7 and Series 66 registrations and Accredited Portfolio Management Advisor (APMA) credentials. [ref: IAPD - Investment Adviser Public Disclosure - Homepage, adviserinfo.sec.gov] [ref: IFMP Financial Advisors Certification] [ref: APMA Certification]

The development of Tijori was influenced by the challenges encountered by retail investors when entering securities markets, including the need to select individual companies, assess investment risk, determine appropriate allocations and monitor securities holdings.

The company sought to address these challenges by developing a digital platform combining model portfolio methodology with securities brokerage infrastructure.

=== Platform development ===
Development of the Tijori software platform took place during 2026, encompassing web and mobile applications, backend services, portfolio management tools and integration with brokerage systems.

Software development was undertaken by a Pakistan-based software development firm. The project included the implementation of account-opening workflows, subscription management, portfolio allocation calculations, order-processing interfaces, investment activity monitoring and administrative functions.

The portfolio management engine was designed to calculate stock allocations based on predefined portfolio models and available investment amounts. Because securities on the Pakistan Stock Exchange are generally traded in whole shares, the software incorporates calculations accounting for share quantities, market prices and residual cash.

Additional functionality was developed to support proportionate investments, partial portfolio liquidation, cash withdrawals and portfolio rebalancing.

The company also developed administrative workflows for reviewing investor information, processing account-related requests and coordinating activities with the executing brokerage firm.

=== Relationship with Chase Securities ===
Tijori established a technology and brokerage integration arrangement with Chase Securities Pakistan (Private) Limited to provide access to regulated securities-market infrastructure.

Chase Securities was incorporated in April 2021 and holds Pakistan Stock Exchange TREC No. 526. It is registered as a securities broker with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan. [ref: About Us - Chase Securities, chasesecurities.com]

Under the operating arrangement, Chase Securities is responsible for brokerage account infrastructure, trade execution, custody arrangements and relevant broker-side compliance functions.

Tijori provides a separate digital interface through which investors can access portfolio construction tools, account information and transaction functionality.

The arrangement separates the software and investment interface from the brokerage services used to execute transactions on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.

=== Commercial introduction ===
During 2026, Shaikha Robo Securities undertook software development, brokerage integration, operational preparation and regulatory processes associated with introducing Tijori to the Pakistani retail investment market.

The platform's initial product structure comprised two subscription-based service tiers: Robo Pro and Robo Elite. [ref: ]

Robo Pro was designed around model portfolio investing, while Robo Elite extended the platform's functionality to include separately managed individual stock selections by users.

The company's commercial strategy emphasized mobile account access, investment education, structured portfolio construction and a subscription-based service model.

The platform will be commercially launched very soon.

== Platform and services ==

=== Investment model ===
Tijori uses a model portfolio approach in which securities are organized into predefined investment allocations.

Rather than requiring investors to independently determine the percentage of their capital to allocate to each security, the platform uses portfolio models that specify target allocations.

The intended allocation depends on the investor's selected risk profile. The platform calculates the share quantities associated with an investment amount, subject to applicable share prices and whole-share trading constraints.

The resulting transactions are presented to the investor for authorization.

As securities prices change, actual portfolio allocations may differ from their original targets. The platform includes rebalancing functionality intended to facilitate adjustments to these allocations.

=== Investor risk profiling ===
The platform uses investor risk profiling to help determine the suitability of available portfolio models.

Its initial risk classifications include:

* Conservative
* Moderate
* Aggressive
* Very Aggressive

These classifications distinguish portfolios according to their intended levels of investment risk and exposure to equity-market fluctuations.

Investor information is collected during account opening, including financial circumstances, investment goals and risk-related preferences.

The risk-profile process is intended to align portfolio selection with the user's stated investment characteristics. It does not eliminate investment risk or guarantee a particular investment outcome.

=== Robo Pro ===
Robo Pro is Tijori's model portfolio investment service, intended primarily for individuals seeking a structured approach to stock-market investing.

The service provides access to predefined stock portfolios constructed according to investment risk classifications.

After completing account onboarding and selecting a portfolio model, users may allocate funds to the portfolio through the application.

The software determines proposed share quantities and investment allocations based on the portfolio's target weights, available capital and relevant market prices.

Users review and authorize the proposed transactions before they are submitted for execution through Chase Securities.

Robo Pro also provides portfolio valuation, holdings information, transaction records and tools for additional investments, withdrawals and portfolio rebalancing.

The model is intended to reduce the amount of individual stock selection and allocation work required of retail investors while maintaining client control over transaction authorization.

=== Robo Elite ===
Robo Elite is an expanded subscription tier combining model portfolio investment functionality with self-directed securities investing. [ref: ]

In addition to the model portfolio features provided through Robo Pro, Robo Elite allows users to select and trade eligible individual securities through a separate self-managed investment section.

The service is intended for investors who wish to maintain a structured model portfolio while exercising independent control over additional stock selections.

The platform distinguishes model portfolio holdings from self-managed holdings to support separate portfolio tracking and transaction management.

Self-directed investment decisions remain the responsibility of the user, while transaction execution is provided through the integrated brokerage infrastructure.

=== Portfolio construction and allocation ===
Tijori's initial model portfolio system uses selected equities listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.

Portfolio models specify target percentage allocations to individual securities. These allocations are used to calculate suggested securities purchases based on the investor's selected model and investment amount.

The platform does not use fractional-share purchases. As a result, actual allocations may differ from target allocations when the investor's available capital cannot be divided precisely according to the model's percentage weights.

Unallocated amounts may remain as cash within the brokerage account.

Additional investments can be calculated with reference to portfolio targets and existing holdings.

=== Rebalancing ===
Portfolio rebalancing is a process through which the composition of an investment portfolio is adjusted toward its intended target allocations.

Tijori includes functionality for calculating securities transactions associated with portfolio rebalancing.

Changes in the market value of individual holdings can cause their weights within a portfolio to increase or decrease over time. Rebalancing calculations determine the securities transactions required to reduce these differences.

The platform's initial design provides for optional, user-authorized rebalancing rather than continuous discretionary trading.

Where rebalancing involves both sales and purchases, the transactions are handled through separate authorization stages.

=== Deposits and withdrawals ===
Tijori provides digital tools for viewing available brokerage cash balances, making additional investments and initiating withdrawals.

The platform distinguishes between balances available for investment and settled balances eligible for withdrawal.

Investors may request withdrawals from their available settled funds. Where a requested withdrawal exceeds the cash available for withdrawal, the platform can calculate securities sales intended to raise the required amount.

Such sales remain subject to market conditions, execution charges, settlement requirements and user authorization.

The platform also supports additional contributions to existing model portfolios, allowing investors to increase their holdings over time according to the selected investment structure.

=== Brokerage integration and transaction execution ===
Securities transactions initiated through Tijori are processed through Chase Securities' brokerage infrastructure.

The platform supports transaction preparation and authorization through its mobile interface. Investors are required to authorize securities orders before they are submitted for execution.

The software is designed around market-order execution during applicable Pakistan Stock Exchange trading hours.

Brokerage commissions, statutory charges and other applicable transaction expenses may apply according to the relevant brokerage arrangements and market requirements.

Securities transactions remain subject to execution availability, prevailing market conditions and settlement procedures.

=== Portfolio monitoring and account activity ===
Tijori provides a portfolio dashboard displaying account valuation, cash information, securities holdings and investment performance.

The application includes transaction records covering securities purchases, sales and other account activity.

Investors can view available cash information, including distinctions between settled and unsettled balances where applicable.

The platform also includes graphical portfolio valuation tools intended to help users monitor changes in account value.

Portfolio valuations reflect securities market prices and account cash balances and may fluctuate due to market movements, transactions and other account activity.

=== Investment education and financial planning tools ===
In addition to transaction functionality, Tijori incorporates educational resources intended for investors with varying levels of experience.

The platform provides articles addressing investment principles, financial markets, risk, portfolio construction and long-term investing.

It also includes a growth-potential calculator that allows users to model hypothetical investment outcomes using variables such as initial investment amount, recurring contributions, investment duration and assumed annual returns. [ref: ]

The calculator produces illustrations based on user-selected assumptions rather than predictions of future market performance.

=== Investment risk ===
Tijori's portfolios are exposed to the risks associated with investing in publicly traded securities.

These include equity-market fluctuations, company-specific developments, liquidity conditions and changes in broader economic and financial-market conditions.

Portfolio diversification and investment allocation methodologies may reduce concentration in individual securities but do not eliminate the possibility of financial loss.

The platform's use of software-based investment calculations does not guarantee investment performance or protect investors against market declines.

data.title: Ham Sandwich sign
data.text:
The Ham Sandwich sign is a road sign near Ham, in Kent. [ref: The Ham Sandwich Sign in Finglesham, Atlas Obscura] It is situated on a triangular traffic island between West Street, West Street Farm Road, and Northbourne Lane. Of the three signs extending from the signpost, it became famous for the one directing to the hamlet of Ham and town of Sandwich, which thus appears to read "Ham Sandwich". [ref: Sandwich – there's more to it than sliced bread, Geographical] Consequently, it has become a landmark attracting visitors globally [ref: The story behind the mysterious Kent village where the sign is more famous than the place, KentLive] and significant social media attention. [ref: Dad insists on hour long detour on roadtrip to visit ‘iconic’ sign in Kent, KentLive] In 2020, a replica sign was erected next to St Peter’s Church, Sandwich, to encourage people back into the town post-COVID. [ref: Town in a pickle as Ham Sandwich sign sparks 'trip hazard' complaint, Kent Online]

data.title: EMU Express
data.text:
EMU Express (legal name Express Mail Universal LLC; ) is a private courier, express mail and logistics company headquartered in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Founded in 2016, it provides domestic and international parcel delivery, cargo transport and fulfillment services for individuals and businesses, including online retailers. As of 2026 the company reported more than 200 branches and service points in Uzbekistan, a fleet of over 250 vehicles and more than 500 employees, as well as a branch network in Kazakhstan.

== History ==

=== Founding ===
EMU Express was founded by Murod Jumaev, who had studied postal communication technologies at the Tashkent University of Information Technologies and from 2008 worked at the Bukhara branch of the national postal operator Oʻzbekiston pochtasi. The idea for the company originated in 2016 as a business-planning project developed by a group of six students during Jumaev's master's studies at the Higher School of Business and Entrepreneurship () in Tashkent; the company was established on 7 November 2016. In its early years the company marketed itself as EMU (ekspress pochta) ("EMU express mail") and used the emu bird as its emblem.

=== Early growth (2017–2020) ===
In 2017 the company offered delivery of documents and parcels within Uzbekistan with a stated delivery time of 24 hours between Tashkent and regional centres. By that year it had offices in regional centres including Andijan, Bukhara, Navoiy, Samarkand, Qarshi, Termez, Nukus, Urgench, Fergana, Namangan, Jizzakh and Gulistan. In January 2018 the company's head office was located in the Yakkasaray district of Tashkent, and its regional network also included Kokand.

By March 2020 the company reported more than 150 employees and a fleet of 30 vehicles, and described itself as a licensed courier operator serving both individuals and businesses, including online shops. In mid-2020 it offered discounted rates for e-commerce businesses depending on shipment volume.

=== Expansion (2021–present) ===
In 2026 the company marked its tenth anniversary. By that year it reported more than 200 branches and service points across Uzbekistan, more than 250 vehicles and over 500 employees, and a network of offices in Kazakhstan, its first market outside Uzbekistan. The same year it launched a mobile application for ordering courier pickups.

== Key figures ==
{| class="wikitable"
|+ Reported operating figures
! Year !! Employees !! Vehicles !! Network !! Source
|-
| 2017 || — || — || Offices in 12 regional centres ||
|-
| 2020 || 150+ || 30 || — ||
|-
| 2026 || 500+ || 250+ || 200+ branches and service points in Uzbekistan; branches in Kazakhstan ||
|}

== Operations ==
EMU Express operates a network of branches and pickup/delivery points across all regions of Uzbekistan, including the Republic of Karakalpakstan. The company's registered office is at 35/1 Shota Rustaveli Street in the Yakkasaray district of Tashkent.

According to the company, shipments are processed through an automated system in which each parcel is scanned at every stage, allowing customers to track shipments online in real time; customers receive SMS notifications on the status of their shipments. The company offers a mobile application for iOS and Android. Some branches are equipped with fitting rooms for customers of online clothing retailers.

=== Kazakhstan ===

Kazakhstan is the company's first market outside Uzbekistan. By 2026 it had opened offices in 17 regions of the country and in three major cities, including Almaty and Astana.

== Services ==
The company's services include:
* express mail and courier delivery within Uzbekistan;
* international mail and courier delivery;
* door-to-door delivery;
* cargo transport and consolidation;
* e-commerce logistics for online stores and marketplaces;
* fulfillment and warehousing;
* B2B and B2C logistics.

== Management ==
As of 2026, the company is headed by its director and founder Murod Jumaev. Jumaev has commented publicly on business regulation in Uzbekistan; in April 2018, during discussion of a proposed 25% tax on dividends, he criticised the measure as a blow to entrepreneurs. He has also published conference papers on youth employment in the digital economy and on regional innovation policy.

== Certification ==
Since November 2021 the company's quality management system has been certified to ISO 9001:2015 for the scope "courier deliveries and truckings" (certificate no. GIUZ-1031-QC, initial certification 10 November 2021; current certificate issued 2 December 2025 and valid until 9 November 2027, subject to annual surveillance). The certificate was issued by G-CERTI, a Seoul-based certification body accredited by the International Accreditation Service.

[user] (Nikan Eskandari) is an Iranian-Canadian recording artist, songwriter, music producer, and multimedia creator based in Toronto, Ontario. He also uses the producer tag NeOnDaTrack and works in music recording, production, and audio engineering.

== Music career ==
[user] released his debut single, Leave It Be, on April 20, 2023. The track was inspired by his experiences during high school, particularly a complicated personal relationship. The song explores emotional conflict, disappointment, and moving on from unhealthy relationships.

On May 2, 2024, he released his second single, I Forgive You. Inspired by personal experiences involving broken trust, dishonesty, and forgiveness, the song addresses emotional struggles, memories of past relationships, personal growth, and moving forward.

On August 24, 2025, [user] released his debut studio album, HTBAB, a 14-track project that had been in development since 2020. The album's title originally stood for Haji These Bees Are Buggin. The decision to include 14 tracks represented the age at which he developed his ambition to pursue music seriously.

The album explores different chapters of his life, including relationships, memories, emotional struggles, and significant personal experiences. Its songwriting draws from autobiographical experiences rather than fictional narratives. HTBABincludes tracks such as Kako, Heart, Sunshine, Feelin, L'amour, Underrated, I Got, Baby, and Calling.

In 2026, [user] continued developing his discography with My Life, alongside projects titled Iran, Monaco, L0V3 Y0U, and Party, with additional releases in development.

Alongside his recording career, he is involved in music production, songwriting, sound design, mixing, mastering, and audio engineering. His production workflow incorporates digital audio workstations such as FL Studio, Logic Pro, and Ableton Live, alongside professional recording equipment, microphones, audio interfaces, mixing consoles, and studio monitors.

== Musical style and influences ==
[user]'s songwriting draws from personal experiences, relationships, and significant life events. His music incorporates melodic vocal performances, contemporary production techniques, and autobiographical storytelling. His creative approach focuses on expressing emotions and personal experiences through lyrics, melodies, and sound.

== Other work ==
Beyond music, [user] works in photography, cinematography, videography, filmmaking, and digital media production. His experience includes operating professional cameras, lenses, lighting equipment, microphones, audio recording systems, and video production accessories.

His visual production work includes creative direction, camera operation, composition, lighting, filming, video editing, photo retouching, colour correction, colour grading, and post-production.

His projects span music-related visual content, promotional photography, social media productions, cinematic video projects, and other multimedia work, combining audio production with visual storytelling.

== Early life and background ==
[user] was born on July 2, 2007, in Tehran, Iran, where he spent his childhood before moving to the Greater Toronto Area in Canada at age of 14. He speaks Persian and English fluently, has some basic knowledge of Turkish, and is learning French.

== Education ==
[user] graduated from High School in ontario and got his high school diploma (OSSD) then he pursued post-secondary education @[user] in the area of Toronto, Ontario, with studies involving photography, cinematography, lighting, digital editing, and visual media production.

[user] maintains an online presence across Instagram, Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, and other digital platforms under the artist name @[user]. His secondary Instagram account, @[user], focuses on photography, videography, and multimedia production.

data.title: Lewis Raven Wallace
data.text:
Lewis Raven Wallace (they/ze/he) is an award-winning journalist, author, and activist for trans rights. His first book, The View from Somewhere: Undoing the Myth of Journalistic Objectivity [ref: The View from Somewhere: Undoing the Myth of Journalistic Objectivity, University of Chicago Press], explores how the ideology of "objective" news reporting in the United States has been a tool of gatekeeping, exclusion, and complicity with racism and transphobia. His second book, Radical Unlearning: The Art and Science of Creating Change from Within [ref: ], draws on the science of neuroplasticity and trauma healing to show how people create the conditions to let go of deeply held beliefs and transform harm. Lewis previously worked in public radio and is a long-time activist engaged in prison abolition, racial justice, and queer and trans liberation.

Career:

Early on in his career, Wallace was the economics reporter and managing editor at WYSO Public Radio in Yellow Springs, Ohio. After his time there, Wallace worked for public radio's Marketplace in the New York bureau. At WYSO, he founded a prison radio project and worked closely with youth radio and community voices programs, teaching community members to make radio stories.

In early 2017, Wallace, then a reporter at American Public Media’s Marketplace, published a piece on his personal blog in which he considered the role of an “objective” press as the country transitioned into a new presidential administration, one that had brought with it transphobia, racism, and regular attacks on the press [ref: Truth-Telling - Columbia Journalism Review, www.cjr.org]. Wallace was fired when he refused to take down the post, which sparked the idea for his first book, The View from Somewhere. He was fired because the post violated Marketplace’s ethics code of journalistic objectivity.

Wallace wrote The View from Somewhere, published in 2019 by the University of Chicago Press [ref: The View from Somewhere: Undoing the Myth of Journalistic Objectivity, University of Chicago Press], an exploration of objectivity in the newsroom and how it has historically silenced marginalized perspectives.

In 2025, Beacon Press published his second book, Radical Unlearning, a guide to unlearning harmful beliefs and changing minds (source).

His third book, Journalism as Resistance, is set for release in May 2027.

Personal life:

Wallace was born and raised in the Midwest. He is currently based in Durham, North Carolina. He is currently a student of history at Duke University [ref: Scholars@Duke publication: Journalism as Resistance: How to Fight Authoritarianism with Movement Media and Grassroots Reporting, scholars.duke.edu].

Awards and nominations:

Wallace has been the recipient of numerous awards and nominations, including the Nieman Visting Journalism Fellow at Harvard University in 2020 [ref: about, Lewis Raven Wallace] and the Abolition Fellowship in 2025. [ref: Lewis Raven Wallace, Interrupting Criminalization]

data.title: Xerocomellus atropurpureus
data.text:
Xerocomellus atropurpureus is a mushroom in the family Boletaceae found along the west coast of North America. Its conservation status is listed as Least Concern according to the IUCN Fungal Redlist.
==Taxonomy==
X. atropurpureus is one of several species within the Xerocomellus genus that were previously considered to be the single species Boletus zelleri. Field studies as well as genetic evidence compiled by J.L. Frank, N. Siegel & C.F. Schwarz between 2016 and 2020 supported the move of many former Boletus species into related various genera and split zelleri into a number of highly similar species.

==Description==
Cap: 4-11 cm; convex to flat; dark brown to near black, often with reddish-purple tones; texture smooth to bumpy or velvety, not developing extensive cracking with age; white bloom sometimes present on young specimens.

Stipe: 4-12 cm; equal or slightly enlarged at base; mostly red, but may be yellow with red striations; may stain blue unpredictably when cut or bruised.

Pore surface: Yellow when young fading to olive-yellow with age; rarely staining blue slowly when bruised.

Spores: Spore print olive brown. Under microscope spores are 11-15 x 4-6 µm and fusiform.

==Habitat and distribution==
Distributed throughout the Pacific Northwest region of the United States and Canada from British Columbia through Northern California, amongst the Cascade and coastal ranges. Mycorrhizal with various conifer species, including but not limited to Douglas fir, Monterey pine, bishop pine, western hemlock, Sitka spruce, and coast redwood. X atropurpureus primarily grows on the ground but may occasionally be found on well-rotted wood.

==Similar species==
X. zelleri - the type species of the genus, X. zelleri is less common than previously believed, and the most likely to be confused for X. atropurpureus. X. zelleri is best differentiated by the cap which is smooth, not bumpy or velvety, and trends medium brown to olive toned rather than reddish-purple, with a distinctive light band at the edge. It is less substantial with a narrower stipe and shows a stronger affinity for growing on wood.

X. diffractus is another of the more common Xerocomellus species on the west coast. It can be easily differentiated by the namesake "cracked cap", which is a lighter olive-brown and develops extensive cracks across the surface with age, often with pink shading. The stipe is primarily yellow with red striations limited to the lower half.

X. mendocinensis, X. rainisiae, and X. amylosporus are all highly similar to X. diffractus in overall appearance and difficult to tell from each other, but may be differentiated from other Xerocomellus species by their aggressive blue staining on both stipe and pore surface when cut or bruised.
